clinical_intent: A treatment plan for cervical brachytherapy was calculated using the wrong source strength due to a decay calculation error. The plan was approved and the first fraction was delivered. The error was discovered during the second fraction QA check. Describe the complete response including dose recalculation, assessment of the dose delivered in the first fraction, patient notification, and corrective actions.
